selection: All original rows whose complete locked released Qwen chat template plus 1024 generation allowance fit8192; no prompt truncation, score-based selection or needle removal. Freeze selected IDs and count before any generation.
metric: Exact original author grade: required random prefix then difflib.SequenceMatcher ratio
limitations: Short-context bounded eligible cohort; not original Table3 128K-1M evaluation, not private Qwen harness or independently trained dense model
source_index_convention: Inferred from raw source: desired_msg_index points to the user request; the next assistant content plus required prefix must equal the original answer. Require the same rule and exactly8 asks across all800 before accepting.
